description: The figure presents two pie charts comparing the distribution of correction outcomes across different types of error detection results in the SIGHAN15 dataset, under the labels "All Changes" and "All Errors." The left chart, titled "All Changes," shows six segments: a large light green slice representing 50% (P), a pale yellow slice at 26% (R), a dark green slice at 4% (PW), a golden yellow slice at 14% (RW), a light blue slice at 1% (N), and a dark blue slice at 5% (NW). The right chart, titled "All Errors," also contains six segments: a dominant light green slice at 56% (P), a pale yellow slice at 29% (R), a dark green slice at 3% (PW), a golden yellow slice at 6% (RW), a light blue slice at 1% (N), and a dark blue slice at 5% (NW). Both charts use the same color-coded legend, where P, PW, R, RW, N, and NW represent different categories of errors based on detection precision and recall, with the "W" suffix indicating correction failure. The percentages are labeled directly on the slices, and the visual representation emphasizes the proportion of correct corrections within each detection category.
